D: A young woman in the kingdom of Rosas makes a wish on a star and stands up to the king who keeps everyone's wishes.
P: Serve dessert when Dahlia brings out her baking.
S: Crusty toast rubbed with garlic and ripe tomato, olive oil and salt
Crusty bread toasted, rubbed with cut garlic and ripe tomato, drizzled with olive oil and finished with sea salt.
Soft goat's cheese rolled in parsley or pistachios, drizzled with honey
Goat's cheese rolled into balls, coated in chopped parsley and crushed pistachios, served with a drizzle of honey.

Potatoes sliced thin on a mandoline, fried at 170C until crisp, tossed with smoked paprika and salt. Slice 600g washed potatoes 1 to 2mm thin on a mandoline. Soak in cold water for 20 minutes to remove starch, then dry very well on tea towels. Heat oil to 170C and fry in small batches for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring, until golden and the bubbling stops. Drain on paper towel. Mix 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp sea salt and a pinch of sugar and toss through while hot. Serve with a sour cream and chive dip.
M: Chicken thighs, chorizo, capsicum and saffron rice
Rice cooked in a wide pan with chicken, chorizo, capsicum, saffron and stock until the bottom crisps, with lemon.

Lamb leg rubbed with garlic, rosemary and lemon, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, with potatoes. Cut slits in a 2kg lamb leg and push in slivers from 4 garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs. Rub with the zest and juice of 1 lemon, olive oil and salt. Roast at 180C for 90 minutes for medium, adding 1kg potatoes in wedges tossed with oil, oregano and lemon juice for the last hour. Rest 15 minutes, carve and serve with the potatoes and a dollop of garlicky Greek yoghurt.
W: Buttery cookies cut into stars and iced yellow
Shortbread cut into stars, baked at 160C for 15 minutes, iced yellow with a little edible glitter.
K: Fresh lemon juice and syrup with orange blossom water, topped with sparkling water
Fresh lemonade with orange blossom water and sparkling water over ice.

note.text: Wishes belong to everyone, not locked away in a tower.

winks: Asha's one hundred year old grandfather

steps.text: Halve the tomatoes and cut the garlic cloves in half. Slice the bread thickly.
Toast the bread until golden.
Rub each slice with garlic, then with tomato.
Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with salt.
Chop the parsley and crush the pistachios.
Roll the cheese into small balls.
Roll half in parsley and half in pistachios.
Arrange on a plate and drizzle with honey.
Slice the chorizo and capsicum.
Brown the chicken and chorizo in a wide pan.
Add the capsicum, rice and saffron, then pour in the hot stock.
Simmer without stirring until the bottom crisps.
Serve with lemon wedges.
Beat the butter and sugar, then mix in the flour.
Roll out and cut into stars.
Bake at 160C.
Cool completely.
Ice yellow with icing sugar, colouring and a little water, then dust with glitter.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Cool.
Squeeze the lemons into a jug and add the syrup and orange blossom water.
Top with sparkling water and ice.

s.note: Crusty toast rubbed with garlic and ripe tomato, olive oil and salt
s.how: Toast thick slices of crusty bread until golden. Rub each with a cut garlic clove, then with half a ripe tomato so the flesh soaks in. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with sea salt flakes. Serve on a board like a Mediterranean market.

s.note: Soft goat's cheese rolled in parsley or pistachios, drizzled with honey
s.how: Roll 200g soft goat's cheese into small balls. Roll half in chopped parsley and half in crushed pistachios. Arrange on a plate and drizzle with honey. Serve to a goat who would very much like a pair of trousers.

m.note: Chicken thighs, chorizo, capsicum and saffron rice
m.how: Brown 600g chicken thighs and a sliced chorizo in a wide pan. Add a sliced red capsicum, 300g paella rice and a pinch of saffron, then 1L hot stock. Simmer without stirring for 20 minutes until the bottom crisps. Serve with lemon wedges.

w.note: Buttery cookies cut into stars and iced yellow
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 100g sugar, then mix in 350g flour. Roll out and cut into stars. Bake at 160C for 15 minutes. Cool, ice yellow with icing sugar and a drop of colouring, then dust with edible glitter. Make a wish on each one.

d.note: Fresh lemon juice and syrup with orange blossom water, topped with sparkling water
d.how: Dissolve 100g sugar in a little hot water and cool. Squeeze 5 lemons into a jug and add the syrup with a few drops of orange blossom water. Top with cold sparkling water and ice. Fragrant as a wish made on a star.
